items.summary: CTO disposition: reject the proposed fleet admission-control-plane build this cycle. It duplicates existing control-plane coverage, while implementation capacity, measurement debt, failed-request repairs, and site overlap remain unresolved. Preserve existing legal, security, attribution, measurement, and release gates. Admit no new implementation until the canonical saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case releases a slot; then admit only the existing allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA request after overlap review. Reconcile conflicting capacity summaries before admission.

CTO handoff: retain the reviewed document-conversion opportunity as capacity-gated research only. Any prototype must use three owner-approved local documents in an isolated disposable workspace, with no dependency installation, production access, external publishing, or telemetry changes. Require provenance and parser-error output plus human review before adoption.

Preserve attribution boundaries. Keep aggregate affiliate clicks and commission explicitly unattributed, require registered tracking IDs for new links, and report clicks, orders, and commission separately. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift from aggregate rows.
